title: The Four Great Joys of Life
synopsis: How did people in ancient China understand human happiness?

fullText.simplified:
人生四大乐事

    你知道吗？中国古人有“人生四大乐事”，他们分别是：“久旱逢甘露”、“他乡遇故知”、“洞房花烛夜”和“金榜题名时”。事情那么多，为什么这四件事会被认为是“四大乐事”呢？接下来听我来一一为大家解答：
    “久旱逢甘露”，意思就是干旱了很久，忽然遇到了一场大雨。就如同等待了很久的事情，终于如愿以偿，怎能不令人欣喜呢？中国自古就是农业大国，古时候，科技不发达，农民主要是靠天吃饭。常年干旱的话，植物无法生长，农民一无所获，吃饭就成了大问题。饭都吃不上，就更顾不上其它事情了！民以食为天，所以“久旱逢甘露”就被列为了人生四大乐事之首。
    “他乡遇故知”，“他乡”就是在外地，“故知”就是老朋友。古时候，交通十分不便利，每每出行，在路上甚至花费上月的时间。这样一来，出门在外，听到家乡话，遇到老友，就成了一件十分难得和幸福的事情。
    “洞房花烛夜”就是新婚之夜。“洞房”是新婚用的新房，“花烛”是古时候结婚点的红蜡烛，上边常常有龙凤的图案。结婚是一个人真正独立，成家立业的开始，当然是一件让家人和自己都很开心的事情了。
    “金榜题名时”，指的是考试成功了。在中国古代，大概有一百多个考生，他们的名字可以被写在金榜上。“金榜”是科举时代终极考试殿试揭晓的榜；“题名”是在榜上写上名字。不得不说科举制是一场豪赌，赌赢了，整个人生都不同了，它是中国古代男子改变命运的主要道路，是读书人最心心念念的事，但也是最难实现的事。很多人花了十几年甚至几十年的时间，就是为了“金榜题名”。如此困难的事情，一旦成功，当然可以算是人生一大乐事。
    慢慢地，随着时代的变迁，经济的发展，科技的提高，古人的人生四大乐事到了现代，有了不一样的味道，有些年轻人甚至用恶搞的方式来调侃自己与这四大乐事半毛钱关系都没有。他们是这样解释的：“久旱逢甘露，一滴。他乡遇故知，债主。洞房花烛夜，隔壁。金榜题名时，做梦。”从这些恶搞的文字，我们可以看出：生活的富足，使人们不再为食物发愁；交通的便利，让距离不成问题；婚姻的压力，使更多年轻人选择了晚婚或者独身；教育的普及，让学习变得没有那么困难。
    有人又总结了现代人的人生“四大乐事”——“吃喝玩乐”。“吃”代表享受美食，体验享受美食过程中的满足感和幸福感；“喝”代表自由，是一种身心的放松；“玩儿”代表追求快乐的方式，在玩儿的过程中，增进亲朋好友间的感情；“乐”代表内心的愉悦，人们可以通过寻找快乐获得心灵的宁静和放松，这种快乐可以来自于学习、工作、社交等各个方面。
    无论是古人的四大乐事还是现代人的四大乐事，都代表了人们最基本的追求和渴望。它们不仅仅是人们在日常生活中所追求的，更是人们心中永远不变的真理。只有在享受四大乐事的过程中，人们才能真正体验到生命的意义和价值，并获得身心的愉悦和满足。

人生四大樂事

    你知道嗎？中國古人有“人生四大樂事”，他們分別是：“久旱逢甘露”、“他鄉遇故知”、“洞房花燭夜”和“金榜題名時”。事情那麼多，為什麼這四件事會被認為是“四大樂事”呢？接下來聽我來一一為大家解答：
    “久旱逢甘露”，意思就是乾旱了很久，忽然遇到了一場大雨。就如同等待了很久的事情，終於如願以償，怎能不令人欣喜呢？中國自古就是農業大國，古時候，科技不發達，農民主要是靠天吃飯。常年乾旱的話，植物無法生長，農民一無所獲，吃飯就成了大問題。飯都吃不上，就更顧不上其它事情了！民以食為天，所以“久旱逢甘露”就被列為了人生四大樂事之首。
    “他鄉遇故知”，“他鄉”就是在外地，“故知”就是老朋友。古時候，交通十分不便利，每每出行，在路上甚至花費上月的時間。這樣一來，出門在外，聽到家鄉話，遇到老友，就成了一件十分難得和幸福的事情。
    “洞房花燭夜”就是新婚之夜。“洞房”是新婚用的新房，“花燭”是古時候結婚點的紅蠟燭，上邊常常有龍鳳的圖案。結婚是一個人真正獨立，成家立業的開始，當然是一件讓家人和自己都很開心的事情了。
    “金榜題名時”，指的是考試成功了。在中國古代，大概有一百多個考生，他們的名字可以被寫在金榜上。“金榜”是科舉時代終極考試殿試揭曉的榜；“題名”是在榜上寫上名字。不得不說科舉制是一場豪賭，賭贏了，整個人生都不同了，它是中國古代男子改變命運的主要道路，是讀書人最心心念念的事，但也是最難實現的事。很多人花了十幾年甚至幾十年的時間，就是為了“金榜題名”。如此困難的事情，一旦成功，當然可以算是人生一大樂事。
    慢慢地，隨著時代的變遷，經濟的發展，科技的提高，古人的人生四大樂事到了現代，有了不一樣的味道，有些年輕人甚至用惡搞的方式來調侃自己與這四大樂事半毛錢關係都沒有。他們是這樣解釋的：“久旱逢甘露，一滴。他鄉遇故知，債主。洞房花燭夜，隔壁。金榜題名時，做夢。”從這些惡搞的文字，我們可以看出：生活的富足，使人們不再為食物發愁；交通的便利，讓距離不成問題；婚姻的壓力，使更多年輕人選擇了晚婚或者獨身；教育的普及，讓學習變得沒有那麼困難。
    有人又總結了現代人的人生“四大樂事”——“吃喝玩樂”。“吃”代表享受美食，體驗享受美食過程中的滿足感和幸福感；“喝”代表自由，是一種身心的放鬆；“玩兒”代表追求快樂的方式，在玩兒的過程中，增進親朋好友間的感情；“樂”代表內心的愉悅，人們可以通過尋找快樂獲得心靈的寧靜和放鬆，這種快樂可以來自於學習、工作、社交等各個方面。
    無論是古人的四大樂事還是現代人的四大樂事，都代表了人們最基本的追求和渴望。牠們不僅僅是人們在日常生活中所追求的，更是人們心中永遠不變的真理。只有在享受四大樂事的過程中，人們才能真正體驗到生命的意義和價值，並獲得身心的愉悅和滿足。

sentences.pinyin: màn man de suí zhe shí dài de biàn qiān jīng jì de fā zhǎn kē jì de tí gāo

sentences.simplified: 古人的人生四大乐事到了现代，有了不一样的味道，
sentences.traditional: 古人的人生四大樂事到了現代，有了不一樣的味道，
sentences.pinyin: gǔ rén de rén shēng sì dà lè shì dào le xiàn dài yǒu le bù yí yàng de wèi dao
sentences.english: Gradually, with the changes of the times, economic development, and the advancement of technology, ..

sentences.simplified: 有些年轻人甚至用恶搞的方式来调侃自己与这四大乐事半毛钱关系都没有。
sentences.traditional: 有些年輕人甚至用惡搞的方式來調侃自己與這四大樂事半毛錢關係都沒有。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē nián qīng rén shèn zhì yòng è gǎo de fāng shì lái tiáo kǎn zì jǐ yǔ zhè sì dà lè shì bàn máo qián guān xi dōu méi yǒu
sentences.english: .. the four great joys of life for ancient people have taken on a different flavor in the modern era.

sentences.simplified: 他们是这样解释的：“久旱逢甘露，一滴。他乡遇故知，债主。
sentences.traditional: 他們是這樣解釋的：“久旱逢甘露，一滴。他鄉遇故知，債主。
sentences.pinyin: tā men shì zhè yàng jiě shì de jiǔ hàn féng gān lù yì dī tā xiāng yù gù zhī zhài zhǔ
sentences.english: Some young people even mock themselves by joking that they have nothing to do whatsoever with these four great joys.

sentences.simplified: 洞房花烛夜，隔壁。金榜题名时，做梦。”
sentences.traditional: 洞房花燭夜，隔壁。金榜題名時，做夢。”
sentences.pinyin: dòng fáng huā zhú yè gé bì jīn bǎng tí míng shí zuò mèng
sentences.english: They explain it like this: “Sweet rain after a long drought, a single drop. Meeting an old friend in a faraway place, a creditor.

sentences.simplified: 从这些恶搞的文字，我们可以看出：生活的富足，使人们不再为食物发愁；
sentences.traditional: 從這些惡搞的文字，我們可以看出：生活的富足，使人們不再為食物發愁；
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhè xiē è gǎo de wén zì wǒ men kě yǐ kàn chū shēng huó de fù zú shǐ rén men bú zài wèi shí wù fā chóu
sentences.english: Spending a candle-lit night in the bridal chamber, a neighbor. To be inscribed on the golden list, a dream.”

sentences.simplified: 交通的便利，让距离不成问题；
sentences.traditional: 交通的便利，讓距離不成問題；
sentences.pinyin: jiāo tōng de biàn lì ràng jù lí bù chéng wèn tí
sentences.english: From this parody, we can see: the abundance of life means people no longer worry about food;

sentences.simplified: 婚姻的压力，使更多年轻人选择了晚婚或者独身；
sentences.traditional: 婚姻的壓力，使更多年輕人選擇了晚婚或者獨身；
sentences.pinyin: hūn yīn de yā lì shǐ gèng duō nián qīng rén xuǎn zé le wǎn hūn huò zhě dú shēn
sentences.english: the convenience of transportation makes distance a non-issue;

sentences.simplified: 教育的普及，让学习变得没有那么困难。
sentences.traditional: 教育的普及，讓學習變得沒有那麼困難。
sentences.pinyin: jiào yù de pǔ jí ràng xué xí biàn de méi yǒu nà me kùn nan
sentences.english: the pressure of marriage leads more young people to choose late marriage or to remain single;
the widespread availability of education has made learning more accessible.

sentences.simplified: 有人又总结了现代人的人生“四大乐事”——“吃喝玩乐”。
sentences.traditional: 有人又總結了現代人的人生“四大樂事”——“吃喝玩樂”。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén yòu zǒng jié le xiàn dài rén de rén shēng sì dà lè shì chī hē wán lè

sentences.simplified: “吃”代表享受美食，体验享受美食过程中的满足感和幸福感；
sentences.traditional: “吃”代表享受美食，體驗享受美食過程中的滿足感和幸福感；
sentences.pinyin: chī dài biǎo xiǎng shòu měi shí tǐ yàn xiǎng shòu měi shí guò chéng zhōng de mǎn zú gǎn hé xìng fú gǎn
sentences.english: Some have summarized the “four great joys” of modern life as “eating, drinking, playing, and being merry”.

sentences.simplified: “喝”代表自由，是一种身心的放松；
sentences.traditional: “喝”代表自由，是一種身心的放鬆；
sentences.pinyin: hē dài biǎo zì yóu shì yì zhǒng shēn xīn de fàng sōng
sentences.english: “Eating” represents the enjoyment of food, experiencing a sense of satisfaction and happiness when enjoying food.

sentences.simplified: “玩儿”代表追求快乐的方式，在玩儿的过程中，增进亲朋好友间的感情；
sentences.traditional: “玩兒”代表追求快樂的方式，在玩兒的過程中，增進親朋好友間的感情；
sentences.pinyin: wán'r dài biǎo zhuī qiú kuài lè de fāng shì zài wán'r de guò chéng zhōng zēng jìn qīn péng hǎo yǒu jiān de gǎn qíng
sentences.english: “Drinking” represents freedom, a relaxation of both body and mind.

sentences.simplified: “乐”代表内心的愉悦，人们可以通过寻找快乐获得心灵的宁静和放松，
sentences.traditional: “樂”代表內心的愉悅，人們可以通過尋找快樂獲得心靈的寧靜和放鬆，
sentences.pinyin: lè dài biǎo nèi xīn de yú yuè rén men kě yǐ tōng guò xún zhǎo kuài lè huò dé xīn líng de níng jìng hé fàng sōng
sentences.english: “Playing” represents the pursuit of happiness, enhancing relationships between friends and family through the process of playing.

sentences.simplified: 这种快乐可以来自于学习、工作、社交等各个方面。
sentences.traditional: 這種快樂可以來自於學習、工作、社交等各個方面。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng kuài lè kě yǐ lái zì yú xué xí gōng zuò shè jiāo děng gè gè fāng miàn
sentences.english: “Being merry” represents inner joy. People can achieve peace of mind and relaxation by seeking happiness.
This happiness can stem from a variety of sources, including learning, work, and social interactions.

sentences.simplified: 无论是古人的四大乐事还是现代人的四大乐事，
sentences.traditional: 無論是古人的四大樂事還是現代人的四大樂事，
sentences.pinyin: wú lùn shì gǔ rén de sì dà lè shì hái shi xiàn dài rén de sì dà lè shì

sentences.simplified: 都代表了人们最基本的追求和渴望。
sentences.traditional: 都代表了人們最基本的追求和渴望。
sentences.pinyin: dōu dài biǎo le rén men zuì jī běn de zhuī qiú hé kě wàng
sentences.english: Whether it’s the four great joys of the ancient people or the four great joys of modern people, ..

sentences.simplified: 它们不仅仅是人们在日常生活中所追求的，更是人们心中永远不变的真理。
sentences.traditional: 牠們不僅僅是人們在日常生活中所追求的，更是人們心中永遠不變的真理。
sentences.pinyin: tā men bù jǐn jǐn shì rén men zài rì cháng shēng huó zhōng suǒ zhuī qiú de gèng shì rén men xīn zhōng yǒng yuǎn bú biàn de zhēn lǐ
sentences.english: .. they both represent people’s most fundamental aspirations and yearnings.

sentences.simplified: 只有在享受四大乐事的过程中，人们才能真正体验到生命的意义和价值，
sentences.traditional: 只有在享受四大樂事的過程中，人們才能真正體驗到生命的意義和價值，
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu zài xiǎng shòu sì dà lè shì de guò chéng zhōng rén men cái néng zhēn zhèng tǐ yàn dào shēng mìng de yì yì hé jià zhí
sentences.english: They are not only what people pursue in their daily lives, but also the eternal truths in people’s hearts.

sentences.simplified: 并获得身心的愉悦和满足。
sentences.traditional: 並獲得身心的愉悅和滿足。
sentences.pinyin: bìng huò dé shēn xīn de yú yuè hé mǎn zú
sentences.english: Only in the process of enjoying the four great pleasures can people truly experience the meaning and value of life, ..

sentence_translations: The Four Great Joys of Life
Did you know? The ancient Chinese had “four great joys of life”.
They were respectively “sweet rain after a long drought”, “meeting an old friend in a faraway place”, ..
.. “spending a candle-lit night in the bridal chamber”, and “to be inscribed on the golden list”.
With so many things in life, why were these four considered the “four great joys”?
Next, listen as I explain them one by one to everyone:
“Sweet rain after a long drought” means that heavy rain suddenly comes after a long period of drought.
Just like finally getting what you wished for after waiting for a long time, how could this not bring joy?
China has been a major agricultural country since ancient times.
In ancient times, with technology being undeveloped, farmers primarily depended on the whims of nature to feed themselves.
In times of persistent drought, plants failed to grow, leaving farmers with nothing and making eating a major problem.
If you can’t even eat then you won’t be able to think about anything else.
People see food as their primary need, so “sweet rain after a long drought” was considered the foremost of life’s four greatest joys.
“Meeting an old friend in a faraway place”, ..
.. “他乡” refers to being away from one’s hometown, and “故知” refers to an old friend.
In ancient times, transportation was very inconvenient.
Every time people traveled, they could spend as long as one month on the road.
Therefore, when away from home, hearing the dialect of one’s hometown and encountering old friends was a very rare and happy event.
“Spending a candle-lit night in the bridal chamber” is the wedding night.
“洞房” is the room used on the wedding night.
“花烛” are the red candles lit during weddings in ancient times, which often featured patterns of dragons and phoenixes.
Marriage is the beginning of a person’s true independence and the establishment of a family and career.
Of course, it’s something that brings happiness to both oneself and family.
“To be inscribed on the golden list” refers to achieving success in examinations.
In ancient China, there were probably more than a hundred candidates whose names could be written on the golden list.
“金榜” refers to the announcement of the results of the final examination, the court examination, during the imperial examination era.
“题名” was having one’s name inscribed on the list.
It has to be said that the imperial examination system was a high-stakes gamble. If you won, your entire life would change.
It was the main path for men in ancient China to change their fate.
It was what scholars yearned for the most, but it was also the hardest to achieve.
Many people spent more than a decade or even several decades just “to be inscribed on the golden list”.
Such a difficult task, once accomplished, could certainly be considered one of life’s great joys.
Gradually, with the changes of the times, economic development, and the advancement of technology, ..
.. the four great joys of life for ancient people have taken on a different flavor in the modern era.
Some young people even mock themselves by joking that they have nothing to do whatsoever with these four great joys.
They explain it like this: “Sweet rain after a long drought, a single drop. Meeting an old friend in a faraway place, a creditor.
Spending a candle-lit night in the bridal chamber, a neighbor. To be inscribed on the golden list, a dream.”
From this parody, we can see: the abundance of life means people no longer worry about food;
the convenience of transportation makes distance a non-issue;
the pressure of marriage leads more young people to choose late marriage or to remain single;
the widespread availability of education has made learning more accessible.
Some have summarized the “four great joys” of modern life as “eating, drinking, playing, and being merry”.
“Eating” represents the enjoyment of food, experiencing a sense of satisfaction and happiness when enjoying food.
“Drinking” represents freedom, a relaxation of both body and mind.
“Playing” represents the pursuit of happiness, enhancing relationships between friends and family through the process of playing.
“Being merry” represents inner joy. People can achieve peace of mind and relaxation by seeking happiness.
This happiness can stem from a variety of sources, including learning, work, and social interactions.
Whether it’s the four great joys of the ancient people or the four great joys of modern people, ..
.. they both represent people’s most fundamental aspirations and yearnings.
They are not only what people pursue in their daily lives, but also the eternal truths in people’s hearts.
Only in the process of enjoying the four great pleasures can people truly experience the meaning and value of life, ..
.. and obtain pleasure and satisfaction in both body and mind.
